office_does: Okanogan County District Court hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases, traffic infractions, limited-value civil cases, small claims and protection orders; its two judges are elected countywide for four years.
race_blurb: Byron Moore, appointed by the county commissioners in October 2025 to replace Judge Chancey Crowell, must win to keep the seat (short and full term). Winthrop Mayor Robert W. Grim, a former District Court and Superior Court judge who resigned from the Superior Court in 2025, wants to return to the District Court bench.

candidates.summary: Okanogan County District Court judge since November 2025 (appointed), previously a Ferry County District Court judge pro tem, an Okanogan County deputy prosecutor and a private attorney.
highlights: Appointed by the county commissioners in October 2025 from four applicants [S3]
Calls his judicial philosophy 'one of restraint' and himself a 'constitutional originalist' [S2][S3]
Judge pro tem in Ferry County District Court from 2023; deputy prosecutor in Okanogan County 2022-23 [S3][S4]
Says community service matters more as recent court decisions limit financial penalties [S5]

judicial.basis: Describes his philosophy as 'restraint', applying the law 'as written' and 'rather than legislating from the bench', and calls himself a 'constitutional originalist'.

experience.basis: The sitting judge, but by appointment since November 2025; his longer record is as pro tem, prosecutor and defense lawyer.

candidates.summary: Mayor of Winthrop and former Okanogan County District Court and Superior Court judge, who resigned from the Superior Court in 2025 and now seeks a District Court seat.
highlights: Lists District Court (2015-2022) and Superior Court (2022-2025) service and about 70 jury trials [S1]
Appointed to the Superior Court in 2022 and elected unopposed in 2022 and 2024 [S2][S6]
Resigned from the Superior Court effective July 1, 2025 to run for Winthrop mayor; would need to resign as mayor if elected [S2][S4]
Did not attend the July 2026 Oroville candidate forum [S7]

experience.basis: About a decade as an elected District and Superior Court judge by his account, the longer judicial record in the race.
